name: combat-writing
description: Combat Writing: a crew of AI model seats attacks your draft. Sparring: every seat rates it 1 to 10 on its first line, 7 forbidden, with its own critique. Battle: every seat reads the others, quotes them by model name, and rates again; a changed rating is checked against the quote. Final reads for signal-to-noise and red flags. Every run leaves a record and a visual board in your project. The rating leads every result; scores are never averaged. Help explains the method.
